settings.a: Delivery to the US takes 7 to 12 business days and shipping is free. You get a tracking link by email as soon as your parcel ships.

settings.q: How does the bundle discount work?
settings.a: Whenever a posture belt and a V-line strap are in your cart together, each strap (up to two) gets $9.99 off automatically. No code needed.

settings.q: Which belt size should I choose?
settings.a: The belt adjusts with velcro. Choose your usual top size, and if you are between sizes, choose the larger one.

settings.q: How long should I wear them?
settings.a: Start with 20 to 30 minutes a day for each. Take them off if anything feels tight or uncomfortable.

settings.q: What if I change my mind?
settings.a: Return unused items within 30 days of delivery. If something arrives damaged, we replace it or refund you.
